note: DRAFT. Case schema, ground-truth policy, exclusions, and metric denominators must be coordinated with Workstream B before finalization (Checkpoint 0 D8). No evaluation run may claim finality against this draft.

case_record.case_id: string; unique within the case set
case_record.revision: full git SHA the case is evaluated at (buggy snapshot)
case_record.bug_report: string; the ticket/issue text used as the query
ground_truth_files: posix paths changed by the human fix
ground_truth_functions: qualified names of functions changed by the human fix
case_record.localizable: bool; false when the fix cannot be attributed to functions/files (e.g. pure config, generated code)
case_record.fix_commit: full git SHA of the human fix
fail_to_pass_tests: optional; tests that indicate the fix

hit_at_k.definition: 1 if any ground-truth function appears in the retrieved/selected set at rank <= k, else 0
hit_at_k.denominator: localizable cases in the frozen case set with non-empty ground_truth_functions
hit_at_k.unlocalizable_cases: excluded from the denominator; counted and reported in excluded_tally with reasons

recall_at_k.definition: fraction of ground-truth functions present in the set at rank <= k
recall_at_k.denominator: sum over localizable cases of len(ground_truth_functions)

first_fix_function_rank.definition: rank of the earliest retrieved ground-truth function; recorded as censored when absent

retrieval_latency_ms.definition: measured wall-clock per case per strategy

item_counts.definition: retrieved and selected counts per case

duplicate_items.definition: count of items sharing an evidence target

source_coverage.definition: distinct files/symbols represented among selected items

comparability_rule: Two arms are comparable only when evaluated on the same case-set fingerprint. Results from different case sets must never be presented as directly equivalent.
case_set_fingerprint: sha256 over the sorted list of (case_id, revision) pairs plus the evaluation contract version
reporting_rules: Report the denominator next to every rate.
Report excluded cases and reasons; never silently drop them.
Record strategy config, contract versions, source revisions, and the exact commands with every result.
Describe results on small samples as a controlled study, not a benchmark claim (spec section 11).
open_questions_for_workstream_b: Q-B7: Ground-truth derivation - are ground_truth_functions the enclosing functions of gold-patch hunks? How are qualified names normalized across renames/moves?
Q-B8: Which k values are primary (e.g. 5/10/20), and which are secondary?
Q-B9: Are file-level Hit@k/Recall@k required in the first evaluation, or function-level only?
Q-B10: Case-set fingerprint method - is the sha256 scheme above acceptable?
Q-B11: Multi-function fixes - any-hit or all-hit for Hit@k?

Q-B12: Initial dataset (D8) - Workstream A proposes a SWE-bench-derived case set on one repository (see docs/workstreams/graph-retrieval-audit.md section 10). Confirm or choose an alternative, including the contamination-reporting policy for pre-cutoff bugs.
